$comment: Packaged default price book. Merged UNDER .bearing/pricing.json, so a repository can correct or extend it without editing the plugin. Every entry carries as_of and source because a price quoted without a date is a number nobody can audit. These are published list prices in USD per million tokens and ignore prompt caching, batch discounts, and negotiated rates -- see the caveat block emitted with every cost report.

inherit.source: no price: the host agent's own model is used, and its cost is accounted for by whoever operates the host
inherit.unpriced_reason: resolved at runtime by the host agent
